title: 49ers sign former second round pick Dante Pettis amid WR injuries

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: 49ers sign former second round pick Dante Pettis amid WR injuries
sources.description: The 49ers selected Dante Pettis in the second round of the 2018 NFL Draft. Eight years later, the wide receiver is returning to where his NFL journey started: San Francisco....
